## Triage: first grade, `bug` · `priority:p2` · `domain:services` · `area:devpath`, into `pm:queue`. Boot-time provisioning honours the flag. `syncObjectSchema` itself is not changed

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-12T09:08Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Why a bug:** `content/docs/deployment/environment-variables.mdx:32` publishes `OS_SKIP_SCHEMA_SYNC=1` as "skip the implicit `db:sync` on boot". `ObjectQLPlugin` says the flag opts a deployment out of DDL (`objectql/src/plugin.ts`, the `skipSchemaSync` docs). `AuditPlugin.provisionSystemTables` issues DDL at `kernel:ready` anyway, and the boot log says none ran.
- **Why p2:** this hits a real deployment shape. objectstack-ai/cloud's control-plane container runs with the flag set, and its read-only probe relies on "no DDL is attempted" (`neon-rtt-probe.yml`). A database role without DDL rights gets a failed DDL it did not ask for.
- **Direction: the fix is in the provisioning plugins, ⛔ not in `syncObjectSchema`:**
  - The flag's declared scope is the boot. `syncObjectSchema` is also the seam a runtime publish uses to give a new object its table (`metadata-protocol` publish). Gating it there would stop Studio-published objects getting tables on such deployments, and nobody has ruled that.
  - So `plugin-audit` and `service-messaging` (the same shape, not measured) skip their boot-time provisioning DDL when the flag is set, and log the skip.
  - They read the value `ObjectQLPlugin` resolved (the option, else the env), ⛔ not a second read of the environment variable. If that needs an engine accessor, the claim declares the `objectql` path.
  - Pin: with the flag set, a dropped audit table stays dropped, and the boot names the skip. With the flag unset, the table is provisioned as today.
- **Serial:** #22985 member 1 touches the same `messaging-service-plugin.ts` function. Whichever claims second sequences after the first.
- Triage: lands in `packages/plugins/plugin-audit` and `packages/services/service-messaging` (`domain:services`); rationale: the boot-time DDL lives there.

Stop on breach; explain in the report.
Container & model: `S, not mechanical (how the plugins read the resolved flag, and what the skip line says, are judgments) ⇒ M treatment`, `mode:subagent`, `model: default — dispatch-gates --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack: "no path-derived mandate … The tier stays the PM's per-card judgment call"`
Clause-②: no (the seat cannot read it without a build: any new name on a package entry's declared surface, an accessor included, flips it; the dev measures on the built declaration closure and stops on a flip)
Responsibility: the two boot-provisioning plugins (this lane's code) issue DDL under the flag | none: objectql honours the flag for its own boot sync only | any deployment that sets `OS_SKIP_SCHEMA_SYNC=1` (objectstack-ai/cloud's control-plane container, per the triage grade); nobody relies on the plugins ignoring it
Thread-read: 6121183235
Serial constraints cleared: no open PR touches `audit-plugin.ts`, `messaging-service-plugin.ts`, `objectql/src/plugin.ts` or `objectql/src/engine.ts` (all 17 non-release open PRs' file lists, read at this claim), and no in-flight `pm:dispatched` claim declares them. #22913's PR #22981 on `audit-plugin.ts` landed as `6a40a09ed`, the base this branch starts from. **Fold-or-serial with #22985** (both touch `messaging-service-plugin.ts` `provisionSystemTables`): ⛔ not folded, because gate ① fails (this card honours a flag, #22985 raises log levels and widens a gate's vocabulary: different defect shape, different fix). Serial: #22985 (p3) is dispatched only after this card lands, as the triage grades on both cards order.

Direction carried into the order is triage's grade `6121183235`, verbatim: the fix is in the provisioning plugins, ⛔ not in `syncObjectSchema`. No maintainer ruling exists on this card.

## Seat ACCEPT: PR #23021 at `8afbc3b90` (`main` merged in since, head `de65696a4`) · landing waits on a green head

`domain:services` seat 1 · `session_01CeRCvvvjxbxu2iYJAc5Cce` · 2026-10-12T10:35Z, under claim `6121579389`. The dev's report is the `os-dev-report` above. Checked on GitHub and on `origin/main`, not from the report.

**Checklist**
- **PR form:** draft, base `main`; the first line is `Fixes #22984`, then the claim's `Clause-②: no` line. The only other card number, #22985, is not near a closing keyword. The assignee is `os-warren`.
- **Scope:** 6 files, +401 / −14: the two plugins and their tests, `packages/objectql/src/plugin.ts`, and one changeset with patches for `plugin-audit`, `service-messaging` and `objectql`. That is the claim's surface plus its pre-declared conditional `objectql` path. Nothing under `content/docs/releases/`. `check-governed-merges --pr 23021`: NOT governed.
- **The ruling held:**
  - `syncObjectSchema` is not gated.
  - Both `provisionSystemTables` methods return before any DDL or probe when `bootSchemaSyncSkipped(engine)` is `true`, and log one `info` line.
  - The value read is the one `ObjectQLPlugin` resolved, published in `init()` as `skipSchemaSync` on the engine instance. There is no second environment read; the seam table's "option `false` + env `1` provisions" row discriminates one.
- **Lane fence (A2) held:** the dev measured that `os migrate apply` creates all twelve tables both plugins provision, on one database, with the telemetry sibling, and with the flag in the migrate run's environment. The skip leaves no documented flag deployment without audit or notification storage.
- **`Clause-②: no` holds (A3):** the property is undeclared, so it is not a member of `ObjectQL` or of `IDataEngine`. The dev compared the built `.d.ts`, comments stripped, base against branch: 10 files identical, with a positive control that detects an injected member. Both plugins already declare `@objectstack/objectql` in `package.json`, so the readers' seam tests importing the real `ObjectQLPlugin` add no dependency.
- **Design note, not a blocker:** an undeclared string-keyed property is a hidden cross-package seam. What holds it is each reader's test booting the real producer. The ablations show those tests going red when the producer stops publishing (audit 2 failed, messaging 2 failed). A declared accessor would be the contract-first form, but it widens the published surface, which is the spec lane's call; this card's order chose to stop short of that. Nothing is filed for it: no reader asks for a declared form today.
- **Changeset:** read sentence by sentence against the diff. "issue no DDL and no existence probe at boot" matches the early return before the loop. "An explicit `skipSchemaSync: false` therefore still provisions under `OS_SKIP_SCHEMA_SYNC=1`" matches the option-first resolution and its seam row. "`syncObjectSchema` is not gated" matches.
- **Tests:**
  - Suites: plugin-audit 761, service-messaging 540, objectql 7936, all passing.
  - Ablations: three legs (both consumers, and the producer with a rebuilt `dist` and its absent-marker preflight), each restored by blob.
  - Integration reading: on base the flag boot re-created the dropped tables. On the branch they stay dropped and the boot names the skip; the CONTROL boot re-creates them.
  - `--ran` reconciles 68 of 68.
- **Deviations:**
  - No `main` merge before the PR opened. The seat merged `main` in through the relay (head `de65696a4`), so parallel discipline ② is met before landing.
  - The shared clone was deepened for `check-engine-split-ratio`.
  - Model-free trailers.
  - `mcp_calls` is 0.

**Serial:** #22985 is `pm:blocked` on this card. Its order carries the shape the dev reported for `messaging-service-plugin.ts` `provisionSystemTables`: the object array first, then the flag early return, then the unchanged `syncObjectSchema` probe and the per-object loop whose catch still logs at `warn`.

**Out-of-scope findings**
- `service-package`'s raw `sys_packages` DDL ignores the flag, and `os migrate apply` does not create that table (measured). Filed as #23022. It is not a port of this fix: its migration coverage has to come first.
- objectql prints its `Skipping schema sync … WITHOUT DDL` line twice per flag boot: Acceptance notes (carrier: none, cosmetic).

## Landed: PR #23021 · `domain:services` seat 1 · 2026-10-12T11:30Z

`session_01CeRCvvvjxbxu2iYJAc5Cce`, under claim `6121579389` and ACCEPT `6122542960`.

- **Merge:** the merge queue merged it at 2026-10-12T11:29:04Z as `d29495113`, an ancestor of `origin/main`. Its queue branch is gone.
- **On `main`:** both `provisionSystemTables` methods carry `bootSchemaSyncSkipped`, and `ObjectQLPlugin` publishes the resolved value (`SKIP_SCHEMA_SYNC_ENGINE_KEY`). `syncObjectSchema` is not gated.
- **Board:** the card closed `completed` through `Fixes`. This write removes `pm:dispatched` and the assignee; domain, area, type and priority labels stay.
- **Unblocks:** #22985 (`Blocked-by: #22984`), released in its own comment.
- **Carried:** #23022 (`sys_packages` raw boot DDL; its migration coverage comes first).
- **Consumer:** objectstack-ai/cloud's control plane sets the flag (per the triage grade). The fix reaches it with the next release of `@objectstack/plugin-audit`, `@objectstack/service-messaging` and `@objectstack/objectql`, and the cloud framework pin that takes it. A merge to `main` does not publish.
